fields.description: Weekly issue featuring local commentary and humor columns alongside civic and political coverage in Greater Miami. Includes discussion of city commission affairs, public finance and publicity spending, proposals for a convention hall and airport planning, street lighting and traffic safety concerns, and waterfront fire protection following a fire at Fisher slip. Also contains items on Prohibition-era liquor enforcement and a federal grand jury in Jacksonville, sports coverage including baseball and boxing, and extensive local advertising and entertainment notices.
